terra.problem: Unclean descendants are cut off if they approach the sacred offerings, not simply because they are unclean.
The verses specify particular kinds of contact; they do not say that touching anything unclean always makes a man unclean until evening.
The printed verses do not identify the offering in verse 19 as a burnt offering. They prohibit putting the listed defective animals on the altar as a food offering, not necessarily for every purpose.
